summary: iter400 — Tested Phase 1 Services Beauté marketplace E2E (FR). Client /beauty loads with all 7 categories + cat-all chips, 37 services rendered (expected ~36, 1 extra — minor), category filter (coiffure: 8 services) + free-text search ('manucure': 2) both work. Booking screen renders all flow controls: loc-salon/loc-home (+15€ home surcharge correctly added: 35€→50€), prov-any + named providers, date+slots, pay-sbpay and pay-cash. For service-b_maq_mariage (online_only), pay-cash button is correctly DISABLED. my-bookings-btn opens beauty-bookings with existing bookings. /pro/beauty with famtester (non-registered) shows pro-register form with all fields (reg-name, reg-cat-{id}, reg-city, reg-bio, reg-submit). /pro/beauty with freeuser shows pro-dashboard (availability='Disponible', 0 feed items, 1 job item — already accepted in earlier runs). /admin/pro-services/beauty loads admin-pro-services: 0 en attente / 7 validés / 11,25€ commission / 63,75€ versé, commission-input=15, 7 provider rows. Marketplace commission flow validated via admin KPI: GMV 75€ across 2 completed bookings → 15% commission (11,25€) + 85% payout (63,75€). ONE UX BUG found.

ui_bugs.issue: The fixed-bottom 'Vérifiez votre email — Activez votre compte pour le sécuriser' banner OVERLAPS the primary CTA 'Payer & réserver / Réserver' (data-testid=confirm-booking). On mobile (430×900) the banner sits flush at the bottom and visually covers the button area. Playwright clicks with force=True intermittently fail (banner intercepts the click), so unverified users may be unable to confirm a booking depending on tap location. Repro: login famtester (unverified), open any service, fill form, scroll to bottom — banner is in front of the gradient bar containing confirm-booking.

issues: Bottom CTA bar should add safe-area / banner offset (e.g., pb-[88px]) when EmailVerificationBanner is visible, or the banner should yield to the active sticky CTA.

action_items: FIX: Email verification banner overlapping confirm-booking CTA. Either (a) increase bottom padding of the booking footer when banner is visible, (b) hide banner on /beauty booking screen, or (c) raise z-index of the CTA bar above the banner.
MINOR: Beauty config returns 37 services instead of expected 36 — verify seed list (likely one extra service was added).
OPTIONAL: Add a 'logout' button to the pro dashboard for test isolation (had to use localStorage.clear).
critical_code_review_comments: BeautyMarketPage.js (330 lines) is healthy in size; consider extracting BookingScreen, BookingsList, and ReviewSheet sub-components if more flows are added.
ProServiceSpacePage.js (239 lines) is fine; register form has no field-level validation feedback — bad input simply gets a server error without highlighting which field.
AdminProServices.js (168 lines) is clean. commission-input has no upper bound; consider 0–50% max validation on the frontend.
Sticky email verification banner (global) should not z-index over per-page sticky CTAs. Add a 'dismissable' or 'context-aware' guard.

success_rate.frontend: 92% (1 high-priority UX overlay bug; all flows functionally verified)

test_credentials: Used famtester@demo.sb / FamTest123! (client), freeuser@demo.sb / FreeUser123! (provider), admin@superapp.com / SuperAdmin123! (admin) — all worked via /login/email.
seed_data_creation: Created additional beauty bookings during testing (admin now shows GMV 75€ / 2 completed prestations / 11.25€ commission / 63.75€ payout). May want to reset for clean state.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All beauty marketplace flows are wired and functional. Only blocker is the email-verification sticky banner overlapping the confirm-booking button on mobile viewport (430px). When testing booking creation with Playwright force=True click sometimes succeeds, sometimes is intercepted by the banner — REAL users tapping that area may miss the CTA. After fix, re-run confirm-booking → beauty-done flow. freeuser already has accepted bookings in pipeline; if testing accept flow, create a fresh prov-any booking first as famtester.
rca_of_the_issue: EmailVerificationBanner is rendered as a fixed-bottom element (position: fixed, bottom: 0) at the App level. BeautyMarketPage booking screen also uses a sticky bottom bar containing 'Payer & réserver'. The two overlap in z-index/space on mobile viewport. Mitigation: (1) raise pb on .beauty-book container to clear the banner; (2) detect banner presence and translate the booking footer up; (3) hide banner on transactional screens. Backend is unaffected — POST /api/pro-services/beauty/bookings succeeds when the click does reach the button (confirmed via earlier successful bookings recorded in admin KPI).
